meta.title: FeatherShot — Qoraallo fudud oo lagu daro sawirrada shaashadda
meta.description: Qaado, qor, oo si degdeg ah u wadaag sawirrada shaashadda. Fallaadho, tillaabooyin tiro leh, calaamado qoraal ah iyo summado muhiim ah, dhammaantood app degdeg ah oo asal ah. Waxaa laga helaa macOS, Windows, Linux iyo Chrome.
hero.badge: ✨ v1.3.51 — Xariiq goos-goos ah iyo qalab cusub oo Qoraal ah

hero.subtitle: Qoraallo fudud oo sawirrada shaashadda lagu darayo — degdeg, asal ah, oo aan wax ku mashquulinayn. Culays la'aan. Rukhsad la'aan. Il furan. Waxaa laga helaa App Store ee iPhone iyo Mac.

features.sub: Wax kasta oo aad u baahan tahay. Wax dheeraad ah maaha.
feature.stepArrow.title: Fallaadhaha tillaabada
feature.stepArrow.text: Fallaadho leh goobo tiro leh oo iskood u kordha — ku habboon hagayaasha tillaabo-tillaabo ah.

feature.stepRectangle.text: Afargeesayaal tiro leh oo iskood u kordha — ku muuji meelaha qoraallo habaysan.
feature.arrow.title: Qalabka fallaadhaha
feature.arrow.text: Sawir fallaadho nadiif ah oo jihaysan oo madax buuxa oo qurxoon leh si aad u tilmaanto faahfaahinta.
feature.rectangle.title: Afargeesle
feature.rectangle.text: Ku muuji meelaha afargeesayaal xariijin leh si dareenka loogu jiido meelo gaar ah.
feature.ellipse.title: Goobo / Ellipse
feature.ellipse.text: Sawir goobo iyo ellipse adigoo jiidaya sanduuq. Xariiq keliya, buuxin la'aan.
feature.line.title: Xariiq
feature.line.text: Sawir xariijimo toosan oo fudud oo aan madax fallaad lahayn.
feature.questionArrow.title: Fallaadhaha su'aasha
feature.questionArrow.text: Fallaadho leh goobo calaamad su'aal ah si loo calaamadiyo meelaha shakiga leh.
feature.questionRectangle.title: Afargeesaha su'aasha
feature.questionRectangle.text: Afargeesayaal leh goobo calaamad su'aal ah si loo calaamadiyo meelaha shakiga leh.

feature.exclamationArrow.text: Fallaadho leh summad cajaa'ib bilowga — muuji digniinaha iyo faahfaahinta aan laga tegin.

feature.exclamationRectangle.text: Afargeesayaal leh summad cajaa'ib geeska sare ee bidix — muuji meelaha muhiimka ah.

feature.text.text: Geli calaamado xor ah shaashadda — guji si aad ugu darto, ku wax ka beddel meesha, oo jiid si aad u dhaqaajiso.

verify.summary: Sida loo hubiyo in soo dejintaadu runtii naga timid
verify.intro: Nooc kasta oo FeatherShot ah waxaa dhisa GitHub Actions kood-ismaha dadweynaha. Faylasha GitHub iyo muraayadda soo dejinteenna waa isku mid, sidaa darteed waxay leeyihiin isku far-gacmeed SHA-256. Markii nooc kasta la sii daayo, GitHub Actions wuxuu sidoo kale fayl kasta ku soo rarayaa VirusTotal, halkaas oo in ka badan 60 mashiinno antivirus ah ay hubiyaan. Natiijooyinka waxaa lagu daraa qoraallada sii deynta.

press.metaDescription: Hantida summadda, sharaxaadaha iyo sawirrada shaashadda ee FeatherShot ee saxaafadda iyo suuqgeynta.
press.meta: Isticmaal agabkan markaad wax ka qorayso FeatherShot. App-ka waxaa leh shatiga MIT; hantida hoose waxaa loo bixiyay isticmaalka tafatirka.
press.shortText: FeatherShot waa qalab degdeg ah oo asal ah oo lagu qoro sawirrada shaashadda oo leh fallaadho, tillaabooyin tiro leh, summado muhiim ah iyo muraayado weyneyn — bilaash iyo il furan ee macOS, Windows iyo Linux.
press.longText: FeatherShot wuxuu kaa caawiyaa inaad qaadato aag shaashadda ah oo aad ku qorto qalab xirfadeed: fallaadhaha tillaabada, afargeesayaal tiro leh, calaamado qoraal ah, summado su'aal iyo cajaa'ib, isku xigxiga ABC, muraayado weyneyn, iyo midabbo iyo dhumucyo xariiq oo dabacsan. Waa fudud yahay, waxay la jaan qaadaysaa menu-bar-ka macOS, wuxuuna yimaadaa rukhsad la'aan iyo xidhitaan daruur la'aan. Noocyada waxaa laga helaa macOS (Swift asal ah), Windows iyo Linux (Electron), iyo sidoo kale kordhiyaha Chrome ee qabashada biraawsarka gudihiisa.
press.screenshotsText: Ku dar sawirrada shaashadda alaabta hoos hosting/public/marketing/screenshots/ ee kaydka. Ilaa markaas, isticmaal astaanta iyo sawirka horudhaca bogga hoose.
privacy.metaDescription: Siyaasadda Qarsoodiga ee app-yada qorista sawirrada shaashadda ee FeatherShot ee macOS, Windows, Linux iyo Chrome.
privacy.meta: Cusboonaysiintii ugu dambaysay: 22 Maarso 2026 · Waxay khusaysaa FeatherShot ee macOS (oo ay ku jirto Mac App Store), Windows, Linux, iyo kordhiyaha Chrome.
privacy.intro: FeatherShot waxaa sameeyay Kurt Steven Kainzmayer (“annaga”). Siyaasaddani waxay sharaxaysaa sida app-ku ula dhaqmo macluumaadka. FeatherShot waxaa loo qaabeeyay inuu ku shaqeeyo gudaha qalabkaaga. Ma hayno akoonno isticmaale mana iibino xogta shakhsiyeed.
privacy.notCollectText: FeatherShot uma baahna gelitaan. Ma ururino magacyo, cinwaannada iimaylka ama macluumaadka lacag bixinta iyadoo la adeegsanayo app-ka. Sawirrada shaashadda iyo qoraallada aad samayso waxay ku hadhaan qalabkaaga ilaa aad doorato inaad ku keydiso, koobiyeyso, ama la wadaagto adigoo isticmaalaya astaamaha nidaamka (tusaale Finder, clipboard, ama app kale oo aad furto).
privacy.permCapture: Qabashada shaashadda — Waa loo baahan yahay si loo qabto oo loo qoro waxa shaashadda ku jira. Qabashadu waxay ka dhacdaa qalabkaaga; ma helno sawirrada shaashaddaada.
privacy.permFiles: Faylasha iyo gallooyinka — Waxaa la isticmaalaa markaad keydiso dhoofinta (tusaale galkaaga Downloads).
privacy.permAccess: Gelitaan ama gelin — Madal qaarkood, rukhsado ikhtiyaari ah ayaa laga yaabaa in la weydiiyo kaliya si loo taageero qabashada ama gaabinta caalamiga ah. Wax nuxur ah noogu gudbin maayo.
privacy.networkText: Noocyada qaar waxay hubin karaan inuu jiro nooc cusub iyagoo la xiriiraya GitHub (xogta sii deynta dadweynaha oo keliya). Hubintan kuma jiraan sawirradaada shaashadda ama xogta qoraalladaada. Waxaad isticmaali kartaa FeatherShot adigoon samayn akoon GitHub ah. App-ka desktop-ka ayaa laga yaabaa inuu furo bogganeena ama boggaga sii deynta GitHub marka aad doorato “soo deji cusboonaysiin” ama ficillo la mid ah.
privacy.masText: Haddii aad FeatherShot ka rakibto Mac App Store, qaybinta iyo cusboonaysiinta waxaa bixiya Apple iyadoo la raacayo shuruudaha Apple. Apple ayaa laga yaabaa inuu habeeyo macluumaadka iibsiga iyo qalabka sida siyaasaddiisa qarsoodiga ah. FeatherShot laftiisu weli ma ururiyo falanqeyn ama xog shakhsiyeed iyada oo loo marayo serferrada annaga.
privacy.childrenText: FeatherShot looma jeedin carruurta ka yar 13 jir, mana ururino si ogaal ah macluumaad shakhsiyeed oo carruur ah.
privacy.retentionText: Nuxurka sawirradaada shaashadda kuma kaydino serferradeena. Fayl kasta oo aad keydiso wuxuu hoos yaalaa gacantaada qalabkaaga.
privacy.rightsText: Haddii sharciga khuseeya uu ku siinayo xuquuq aad ku gaarto, sixiso, ama tirtirto xogta shakhsiyeed, nala soo xiriir hoos. Maadaama aynaan hayn akoonno ama kayd daruur ah oo sawirradaada ah, codsiyada intooda badan waxay khusayaan farriimaha ikhtiyaarka ah ee aad si toos ah noogu soo dirto.
privacy.changesText: Waxaan cusboonaysiin karnaa siyaasaddan. Taariikhda “Cusboonaysiintii ugu dambaysay” ee kore ayaa isbeddeli doonta markaan sidaas samayno. Ku sii socoshada isticmaalka app-ka ka dib isbeddellada waxay macnaheedu yahay inaad aqbashay siyaasadda la cusboonaysiiyay.
privacy.contactText: Su'aalaha qarsoodiga: GitHub Issues ama iimayl adigoo isticmaalaya doorashada xiriirka ee profile-kayaga GitHub.
support.metaDescription: Caawimaad iyo taageero FeatherShot, app-ka qorista sawirrada shaashadda ee macOS, Windows, Linux iyo Chrome.
support.meta: FeatherShot waa bilaash iyo il furan. Boggani wuxuu jawaabaa su'aalaha ugu badan ee ku saabsan app-ka macOS, Windows, Linux, iyo kordhiyaha Chrome.
support.helpText: Ka warbixi cilad, codso astaan, ama weydii su'aal GitHub Issues. Markaad warbixinayso dhibaato, ku dar nooca FeatherShot ee aad isticmaalayso (waxaa lagu muujiyaa menu-ga) iyo nooca macOS, Windows ama Linux. Windows iyo Linux, Show Log File ee menu-ga tray-ga wuxuu furaa log aad ku lifaaqi karto warbixinta.
support.screenRecordingText: FeatherShot wuxuu u baahan yahay rukhsadda Screen Recording si uu u qabto shaashaddaada. Haddii qabashadu madhan timaado ama doorashadu aysan muuqan, fur System Settings → Privacy & Security → Screen Recording, daar FeatherShot, oo mar kale bilow qabashada. macOS ayaa laga yaabaa inuu kuu sheego inaad xidho oo mar kale furto FeatherShot ka dib markaad beddesho dejintan.
support.downloadsText: Save & Copy wuxuu galka Downloads ku qoraa PNG leh calaamad waqti. macOS wuxuu rukhsad weydiiyaa markii ugu horreysay. Haddii aad diiday, FeatherShot ka ogolow System Settings → Privacy & Security → Files and Folders. Koobiyeynta clipboard-ka way shaqeysaa labada xaaladood.
support.whereText: Sawirrada shaashadda ee la keydiyay waxay ku jiraan galkaaga Downloads iyagoo magaca faylka ku leh calaamad waqti. Koobiyaduhu waxay aadaan clipboard-ka, sidaa darteed si toos ah ayaad ugu dhejin kartaa app kale. FeatherShot koobi kuma hayo serferradeena, mana soo rarayo sawirradaada shaashadda meel kasta.
support.shortcutsText: Qalab kasta oo qoraal ah wuxuu leeyahay gaabin lagu muujiyo tooltip-kiisa (furayaasha 1 ilaa 0, -, =, T iyo M). ⌘Z (Ctrl+Z Windows iyo Linux) wuxuu laalaa isbeddelkii ugu dambeeyay, ⌘S (Ctrl+S) wuxuu keydiyaa oo koobiyeeyaa sawirka shaashadda. ⌘+, ⌘− iyo ⌘0 waxay weyneeyaan, yaraynayaan, oo muujiyaan sawirka cabbirkiisii asalka ahaa. ⌘9 wuxuu ku habeeyaa daaqadda.
support.updatesText: Noocyada Mac App Store iyo TestFlight waxaa cusboonaysiiya Apple. Soo dejinta GitHub iyo boggan waxay menu-ga ka hubin karaan nooc cusub. Sii deyn kasta waxaa lagu liisgareeyay diiwaanka isbeddellada.
support.privacyText: FeatherShot akoonno ma laha mana dirayo sawirradaada shaashadda meel kasta. Akhri siyaasadda qarsoodiga oo dhammaystiran.
